latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of AI Add Music To Video.

- Upload MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM video files up to 500MB.
- Quickly add background music matching your video's mood using natural language instructions.
- Automatic setup and session management — no manual API configuration needed.
- Cloud-based rendering and export: get music-backed videos back in 30–60 seconds.
- Supports checking credits/balance, viewing current timeline state, and exporting edited videos.
- Error handling and tips for fastest, most accurate results built-in.
